title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Belgium – EGF/2026/001 BE/Cora
part_text: 12. Calls for thorough final evaluations of the measures implemented, including clear information on the use of funds, the success of the reintegration of workers into the labour market and its effectiveness, to ensure accountability, sound financial management and the effective use of Union funds; reiterates the need for appropriate monitoring and control of the use of EGF funding and whether the EGF objectives were achieved; stresses that expenditure must be substantiated and subject to effective checks; calls on the Commission to ensure that unused amounts and expenditure found to be ineligible are recovered in accordance with the applicable rules, and that the final evaluation clearly identifies actual participation, employment outcomes and administrative costs;
